biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend opens a NEW personal checking account and, within 60 days, enrolls in Digital Banking plus sets up a direct deposit (any amount) or keeps a $100 balance. If your friend joins but just parks the account idle, you earn nothing.
catches: Friend must open a new First Service personal checking account and within 60 days: (1) enroll in Digital Banking, and (2) set up a direct deposit of any amount OR maintain a $100 balance in the checking account.
Referrer must be a current First Service Credit Union member in good standing; if the referrer is not a member, no reward is sent to either party.
$50 reward deposited to the referrer's First Service checking account within 2 weeks of all requirements being completed.
Program support is handled by ReferLive (info@referlive.com).
No stated referral cap and no stated expiration on the fetched page.
No 1099/tax disclosure on the fetched page.

steps: Register for the refer-a-friend program and get your referral link.
Share your referral link with friends and family.
Your friend opens a new First Service personal checking account via your link.
Within 60 days, your friend enrolls in Digital Banking and sets up a direct deposit of any amount OR maintains a $100 checking balance.
You and your friend each receive a $50 deposit to your First Service checking accounts within 2 weeks.
